map.计算医院床位使用率、床位周转次数、平均住院日等核心运营指标，评估床位资源配置效率: Computes core operating indicators such as hospital bed occupancy rate, bed turnover and average length of stay, evaluating the efficiency of bed resource allocation.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：occupiedDays ÷ openBedDays: Core formula (by input variables): occupiedDays ÷ openBedDays × 100
map.📖 查看「床位使用率 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to bed occupancy rate
map.科室月度运营统计：按平均开放床位数与统计天数算出实际开放总床日数，再用实际占用床: Department monthly operating statistics: from the average number of open beds and the number of days in the period, compute the total open bed-days, then use the occupied bed-days to get the bed occupancy rate and evaluate whether utilization sits in the reasonable 85-93% range.
map.结合出院人数算床位周转次数（出院人数 ÷ 平均开放床位）与平均住院日（占用床日: Combine the number of discharges to compute bed turnover (discharges ÷ average open beds) and average length of stay (occupied bed-days ÷ discharges), identifying the case mix and operating efficiency.
map.使用率可视化对照目标区间（85% 合理下限、93% 上限），>95% 提示超负荷: Visualize utilization against the target range (85% reasonable lower bound, 93% upper bound); above 95% indicates overload and below 70% indicates idle capacity, supporting decisions on bed capacity adjustment.
map.示例：某科开放 50 床、统计 30 天、占用 1200 床日、出院 140 人: Example: a department with 50 open beds over 30 days, 1,200 occupied bed-days and 140 discharges
map.开放总床日 = 50 × 30 = 1500；使用率 = 1200 ÷ 1500: Total open bed-days = 50 × 30 = 1500; occupancy = 1200 ÷ 1500 × 100% = 80.0% (low); turnover = 140 ÷ 50 = 2.80 times (normal); average length of stay = 1200 ÷ 140 ≈ 8.57 days (short); bed turnover days = 30 ÷ 2.80 ≈ 10.71 days.
map.床位使用率越高越好吗？: Is a higher bed occupancy rate always better?
map.并非越高越好。85–93% 为合理高效区间；>95% 属超负荷，存在安全隐患与加: Not always. 85-93% is the reasonable and efficient range; above 95% means overload, with safety risks and the need for extra beds; below 70% means idle resources, so the case mix or the scale needs adjusting.
map.平均住院日和周转次数有什么关系？: What is the relationship between average length of stay and bed turnover?
map.两者近似互为倒数（周转日 ≈ 天数 ÷ 周转次数）。平均住院日越短、周转次数越高: The two are roughly reciprocals (bed turnover days ≈ number of days ÷ turnover). The shorter the average length of stay and the higher the turnover, the faster beds circulate and the higher the operating efficiency.
